CREATE TABLE hosted_completions (
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	payload_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id, generation), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE hosted_executors (
	incarnation VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	protocol_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	image_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (worker_id), 
	CONSTRAINT hosted_executors_capacity_check CHECK (capacity BETWEEN 0 AND 64)
)

CREATE TABLE hosted_model_requests (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	request_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	request_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cost_microusd INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	dispatched_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	settle_by DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	settled_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_hosted_model_request_key UNIQUE (run_id, request_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_hosted_request_state CHECK (state IN ('PENDING','COMPLETED','UNCERTAIN')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_hosted_request_usage CHECK (generation >= 1 AND input_tokens >= 0 AND output_tokens >= 0 AND cost_microusd >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE hosted_run_artifacts (
	artifact_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	path VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (artifact_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_hosted_export_path UNIQUE (run_id, generation, path), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE hosted_slots (
	worker_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quarantined BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	run_id CHAR(32), 
	generation INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (worker_id, ordinal), 
	CONSTRAINT hosted_slots_ordinal_check CHECK (ordinal BETWEEN 0 AND 63), 
	CONSTRAINT hosted_slots_check CHECK ((run_id IS NULL) = (generation IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(worker_id) REFERENCES hosted_executors (worker_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id)
)
